2023_032_apr_2023_pcard_report.paragraph: Purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction report for Troy School District covering April 2023, carried on the June 13, 2023 Board of Education agenda. The 36-page listing, printed 6/8/2023, itemizes every card charge and credit by transaction description, journal-entry description (uniformly "APR PCARD EXP"), budget unit, account code, transaction amount and credit, with posting dates running from 3/28/2023 through 4/25/2023. The report closes with a subtotal of $293,063.72 in transaction amounts against $5,317.70 in credits and a stated "Total Expens" of $287,746.02.

**Report identity**

**Format**
Six columns repeat on every page: Transaction Description, JE Description, Budget Unit, A/C Code, Transaction Amount, Credits. Each transaction description begins with the posting date and a truncated merchant name (for example "4/17/2023-EXPLORELEARN"). The journal-entry description is "APR PCARD EXP" on every line. Posting dates span 3/28/2023 through 4/25/2023, so a handful of late-March charges appear in the April cycle.
